review_candidates.description: Description Location: Lagos Nigeria Position Status: Full-Time, National Salary Level: National Risk Level: ☐ Level 3 ☐Level 2 ☐Level 1 (Level 3: Frequent contact with participants, direct contact with children, access to sensitive data, and/or high level of accountability. Level 1: Likely to have no contact with participants or sensitive data) TL;DR; If you want to lead one of Africa’s most ambitious efforts to get young people into safe, dignified work, and shape how the Mastercard Foundation and the wider sector think about the future of work for young women, refugees and persons with disabilities, this is your role. You’ll thrive here if you love building partnerships that deliver real results. About Prosper Global Barely enough is not enough for anyone. Prosper Global is a humanitarian organization working alongside communities facing conflict, climate change, and economic hardship to meet urgent needs and create the conditions for lasting progress. Today's challenges demand new solutions, so we pair local knowledge with global resources to help communities build what's needed, test what's possible, and scale what's proven so that people everywhere can pursue a full life on their own terms. In 2026, we changed our name from Mercy Corps to Prosper Global, to reflect our belief that when every community can prosper, all of humanity moves forward. About Prosper Global, The Jobtech Alliance And DAWN Prosper Global (formerly Mercy Corps) is a global humanitarian organization working in over 40 countries at the front lines of today’s biggest crises. Prosper Global has built a reputation for innovative economic development programming, particularly working with start-ups, and hosts a venture capital arm called Prosper Global Ventures. In late 2021, Prosper Global launched the Jobtech Alliance, a Pan-African ecosystem-building initiative around inclusive jobtech in Africa. These are digital platform creating work opportunities for users, including gig-matching platforms, e-commerce platforms are more. The Jobtech Alliance has a portfolio of grants for acceleration activities with jobtech startups, and wider ecosystem-building. We learn by doing, conduct research to better understand what makes these innovations work (or not), and explore emerging themes to help define and guide the sector. Digital Advancement for Women Now (DAWN) is a four-year project in Nigeria, funded by the Mastercard Foundation and implemented within the Jobtech Alliance. It enables underserved young people, with a particular focus on young women, alongside refugees and displaced people and persons with disabilities, to access safe, inclusive and dignified work through jobtech startups. Position Summary The Project Director is the senior leader responsible for the implementation of DAWN in Nigeria, accountable for delivering the project’s commitments to the Mastercard Foundation: supporting 132,000 financially disadvantaged young people into work on digital platforms over four years (at least 70% young women, 5% refugees and displaced people and 5% persons with disabilities), beginning with a one-year Learning Pilot that will generate the evidence to shape scale-up. Working with consortium partners BFA Global and ImpactHER, and with platforms, skilling providers and inclusivity partners across at least four to six states, the Project Director sets the direction for delivery and keeps the project on track against its approved workplan, budget and targets. Critically, the Project Director owns the relationship with the Mastercard Foundation. This means leading every day-to-day interaction with the Foundation, anticipating its expectations, producing high-quality and timely reports, and building the trust and credibility that allow DAWN to adapt and grow as the evidence emerges. The Project Director reports to the Jobtech Alliance Program Director, line manages team members working on inclusivity and inclusivity partners and works collaboratively in a matrixed form with different teams within the Jobtech Alliance and other members of the consortium. Essential Responsibilities Donor Management – 50% Lead the Mastercard Foundation relationship. Act as the single accountable point of contact for the DAWN programme. Build trusted relationships at working and senior levels, run regular check-ins, and make sure the Foundation hears about progress, risks and issues from DAWN. Run the governance cadence. Prepare for and lead DAWN’s engagement in the Foundation-facing forums set out in the grant agreement and workplan, including the kick-off workshop, monthly check-ins, the Project Management Team, the Strategic Advisory Committee, the Platform Selection Committee and the annual learning convening. Make sure decisions, actions and follow-ups are clear, timely and documented. Own reporting quality and timeliness. Be accountable for submission of all contractual reports, including the inception report, semi-annual and annual narrative and financial reports, quarterly status updates and the Learning Pilot evaluation report. Coordinate inputs from Finance, MEL and consortium partners, challenge weak evidence, and secure Jobtech Alliance Program Director approval before anything formal goes to the Foundation. Manage approvals and change. Maintain a live register of every action that requires the Foundation’s prior written approval (for example adding or replacing implementing partners or their budgets, material changes to activities, targets, eligibility criteria or platform partners, reallocation of device-subsidy funds, and official communications). Prepare well-evidenced, well-timed requests so that approvals do not delay delivery. Anticipate and resolve friction. Work with a highly engaged funder with exacting standards for evidence, compliance and safeguarding. Understand what the Foundation needs, respond promptly and constructively to challenge, negotiate pragmatic solutions, and escalate early to the Jobtech Alliance Program Director where positions diverge. Never make a commitment to the Foundation that the project cannot deliver. Manage monitoring, audit and information requests. Make sure records and supporting documentation can be produced quickly to meet Foundation requests and any audit or monitoring visits, working closely with Finance and Operations. Lead on field visits with the foundation as required. Use the Learning Pilot to build confidence. Lead the Foundation conversation on pilot results, benchmarks and recommendations, and shape evidence-based proposals for any refinements to the design, budget or scale-up strategy. Safeguard the partnership. Make sure that any event likely to affect delivery, compliance or reputation, including safeguarding concerns and suspected fraud or misuse of funds, is escalated immediately and communicated to the Program Director and Foundation as the grant agreement requires. Project, Budget and Implementation Management 35% Lead the delivery of DAWN in Nigeria against the approved workplan, budget and targets, including the year-by-year milestones for youth transitioned into work, skilling, asset and device support, platform engagement, research and convenings. Lead on local adaptations, advising on geographies and approaches for implementation (recognising the need for 50% of participants to be outside of Lagos/Abuja). Work with Inclusivity team to ensure technical guidance and standards shape inclusion delivery against population targets Line manage the Senior Project Manager responsible for managing Inclusivity Partners holding him/her accountable to deliver interventions against targets, and ensure activities evolve to respond to emerging needs.Work with Finance to monitor budget against actuals, manage within approved flexibility, and ensure financial controls and documentation are in place across the project and its partners. Work with the Results, Learning & Research Team to ensure that the first year pilot delivers on its learning requirements and can justify subsequent scale-up. Lead on matrixed communications with different technical leads including those responsible for Inclusivity, Venture Support, Results Measurement, Research and Ecosystem. HQ management. Collaborate with Prosper Global HQ responsible for funder management. Represent DAWN with platforms, government, private sector, civil society and the wider Nigerian jobtech and youth employment ecosystem, and identify partnerships that might be of value to the project. Set and track DAWN’s Objectives and Workplan, linked to the Jobtech Alliance’s systems change domains, and use them to keep the team and partners focused on the priorities that matter most. Country Operations - 10% Lead the social and performance culture of the Jobtech Alliance’s Nigeria team, so people do their best work and enjoy it. Support services: Ensure that the DAWN Nigeria team (and visiting team members) have what they need to thrive, including suitable office space, logistics and more. Risk, Compliance and Safeguarding - 5% Make sure safeguarding is embedded across all activities and partners, including the community accountability and reporting mechanism, and that the Foundation’s Code of Conduct and Child and Youth Safeguarding requirements are met. Function as the ultimate in-country point of escalation and accountability. Practices the values of Mercy Corps including respecting the dignity and well-being of participants and fellow team members. Encourages openness and communication in their team; encourages team members to submit reports if they have any concerns using reporting mechanisms e.g., Integrity Hotline and other options. Occasional regional or international travel may be required. Success Factors You are a credible, composed and diplomatic leader who builds trust with funders and partners easily, and you know how to keep a demanding relationship constructive. You are comfortable with ambiguity, capable of building coherence in strategy and implementation with a lot of moving parts and people. You are a hands-on doer energised by building something from the ground up, moving fast, and keeping partners, participants and activities moving, and are always ready to get your hands dirty.
